item.description:
Unstall 0.8.2 makes voice cards easier to follow and answer.
- Each card opens before speaking and gives one plain sentence, without reading symbol names aloud. - A chime and glow show when Unstall is listening. - Answer with yes, no, an option, or your own words. Free-form replies are read back before sending. - A plain yes approves at once. Risky commands and free-form replies get one confirmation.
Voice remains off by default. Existing preferences are preserved. Automatic update checks are enabled by default; installing an update remains your choice.
The ZIP is for in-app updates. The DMG is for manual installation. Both are signed and notarized by Voxtur Inc.
